title: cyrtococcum trigonum
intro: Cyrtococcum trigonum, commonly known as Trigonella, is a type of plant species in the legume family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cyrtococcum trigonum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Cyrtococcum trigonum include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
